chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali ibn Ra'ab, from Ibn Muskan, from Al-Halbi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the brothers from the mother with the grandfather, he (peace be upon him) said: 'For the brothers from the mother with the grandfather, their share is the third with the grandfather'.

key_terms.الْإِخْوَةِ مِنَ الْأُمِّ: Maternal half-brothers (sharing the mother but not the father)
key_terms.الْجَدِّ: The grandfather (specifically paternal in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of maternal half-brothers when the paternal grandfather is alive?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the inheritance share of maternal half-brothers (ikhwah min al-umm) as one-third when the paternal grandfather (jadd) is present, a ruling that distinguishes them from full or paternal half-brothers who typically receive a larger portion. This specific allocation underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that the grandfather, in the absence of a father, assumes a position of precedence, thereby limiting the share of maternal relatives to the fixed portion of the Quranic heirs (dhawu al-furud). The narration reflects the detailed application of inheritance laws derived from the Prophet and Imams, ensuring equitable distribution among diverse kinship ties.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Ibn Muskan, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the brothers from the mother, with the grandfather. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the brothers from the mother with the grandfather, their share is the third with the grandfather’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ri’ab from ibn Muskan from al- Halabiy who has narrated the following:
“About the case of brothers from one’s mother with a grandfather, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The share of brothers from one’s mother is one-third if a grandfather is with them.’”
